ios.desc:
Pingee – Smart Reminders for Real People
Pingee enables you to assign voice or text reminders to anyone - family, friends, roommates, or teams. Recipients receive the notification directly, while you can track completion in real time, ensuring everyone stays organized and on schedule.

Imagine being in an important meeting and suddenly remembering your child’s project deadline the next day. Instead of making a call, simply assign a reminder through Pingee. Your message – especially in your own voice – will reach them at the right time.

Whether you are caring for an aging parent, managing household responsibilities, or coordinating a trip, Pingee ensures that tasks are clearly assigned and completed. No more confusion or missed responsibilities.

How Pingee Works:
• Create a reminder using voice or text
• Assign it to an individual or group
• Receive notifications when tasks are completed or pending

Direct Task Assignment:
• Assign reminders to individuals or groups
• Notifications are delivered directly to recipients
• Track completion status and pending tasks with ease

Voice Reminders:
• Record a voice message or type your reminder
• Audio reminders play at the scheduled time
• A more personal and effective way to ensure tasks are not overlooked

Daily Summaries:
• Morning overview of scheduled reminders
• Evening summary of pending and overdue tasks
• Flexible notification timing customizable in Settings

Group Collaboration:
Ideal for families, roommates, care teams, school schedules, travel planning, and workplace coordination. Everyone can clearly view their responsibilities and track progress.

Smart Features:
• Alarm alerts for high-priority reminders
• Real-time completion tracking
• Calendar synchronization with iPhone Calendar and Reminders (data remains local)
• QR code-based connections
• Simple and intuitive design suitable for all age groups

Privacy and Security:
• All reminder text and voice recordings are encrypted
• Calendar data remains on your device and is not shared externally
• Face ID / Touch ID protection available
• Full control over who can assign and view reminders

Perfect For:
• Busy families and parents
• Individuals caring for aging parents
• Shared households and roommates
• Friends organizing trips or events
• Teams requiring simple and effective task coordination

Unlike traditional reminder apps that notify only you, Pingee ensures that the right people receive the right reminders at the right time.

Download Pingee t

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built Pingee after running into a small but frustrating problem.

Sometimes I'd remember something important for my family — like my father's medication or my kid's school task — but I couldn't call them immediately because I was in a meeting or driving.

Most reminder apps notify you, but that doesn't help when someone else needs to be reminded.

Pingee lets you assign reminders directly to family or friends, and they receive the notification instead of just you. You can also record voice reminders so they hear the message in your own voice at the scheduled time.

It supports small family groups, daily summaries, and privacy features like encrypted reminder text/audio and Face ID lock.

Curious what people think and happy to answer any questions.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759873843
